item.title: Dizzee Rascal Announces 2026 Australian and New Zealand Tour With Example and Arrdee
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey music lovers, get ready for some exciting news! Dizzee Rascal is heading back to Australia and New Zealand this November and December for his We Want Bass tour. And he's not coming alone - he'll be joined by U.K. dance act Example, rapper Arrdee, and Perth DJ Swaglord Savannah for seven epic shows."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The tour kicks off in Perth on November 26th and will make its way through Brisbane, Adelaide, Melbourne, Sydney, and Byron Bay before wrapping up in Auckland on December 8th. But here's the catch - the support lineup varies by city, so make sure to check who's playing where. Mastercard and Live Nation presales start July 8th, and general tickets go on sale July 9th at 1 p.m. local time."
[Short music transition]
Host: "For those who may not know, Dizzee Rascal is a grime legend, born Dylan Mills. His debut album 'Boy in da Corner' won the prestigious Mercury Prize back in 2003, making him the youngest winner at just 19 years old. And let's not forget his commercial peak with 'Tongue n' Cheek' in 2009, which produced four consecutive U.K. No. 1 singles. He's a music icon, and we can't wait to see him perform live."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, mark your calendars and get ready to groove with Dizzee Rascal and friends. Don't miss out on the We Want Bass tour - get your tickets now and experience the energy for yourself!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
